warnings: Four truss elevations of the same pattern on one sheet, kept in one section file (one element per truss). Every truss's members carry the same callout 'rectangular tube Ø-100x50x2.3 mm.'; the printed symbol before 100x50 is a slashed rectangle, read as a rectangular hollow (box) section — designation RHS, print kept in printed_as.
Each elevation also points at the อะเส below it, printed 'อะเส 2C-150x50x20x2.3 mm.' — the same member recorded on the S-03 beam_plan file, not repeated here.

Panel chains and the grid markers under each elevation are recorded in the grid master (dimension_chains); their ticks became dummy lines per section 4 rule 4. T4's printed segments sum to 4.02 against its printed total 4.00 — kept as printed.
